Zydis 4.1 amalgamated build (`Zydis.c` / `Zydis.h`), unmodified, as shipped in
[MWCrashFix `veh-experimental`](https://github.com/x0reaxeax/MWCrashFix/tree/veh-experimental).
Upstream: https://github.com/zyantific/zydis - MIT License, see `LICENSE`.
ChaseGuard uses only the decoder (no formatter, no libc: `ZYAN_NO_LIBC`).
